summary.text: Judy Trombetta is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 166, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Joe Walker.
She is president of the Haverford Township Board of Commissioners and a social worker by training, according to her Ballotpedia survey response.

paragraphs.text: Judy Trombetta graduated from West Chester Henderson High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Temple University in 2008 and a graduate degree from the University of Pittsburgh in 2009.
In her 2026 Ballotpedia survey response, she said she holds a Master of Social Work from the University of Pittsburgh and a Bachelor of Social Work from Temple University.
She described more than 15 years of experience in government, nonprofit leadership and community engagement, and said she is a longtime Havertown resident.
Trombetta advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.

She said she would open an ADA-accessible district office, hold regular town halls and publish a newsletter, and she listed housing, consumer protection, healthcare, education and small business among her policy interests.
